lines.text: Sammy the squirrel loved leaping from high oak branches across the sunny park!
Be careful near the windy bridge! warned Mama Squirrel with a loving smile.
I'm a big boy now, I don't need warnings! Sammy chattered, dashing across the planks!
WHOOSH! A giant gust of winter wind blew his prize acorn right off the edge!
Sammy scrambled and slipped, dangling by his tiny front paws!
Mama swung down with lightning speed, pulling him back to the safe, solid wood!
Parents give warnings not to stop fun, but to protect you from unseen dangers!
Sammy hugged Mama tight and promised to always listen to her caring advice!
Listen and learn—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily adventures!
